description: 제주특별자치도_버스정보시스템 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 제주특별자치도. 제주도 시설물정보(CCTV,VMS,AVI,VDS 등)와 표준노드링크 기반 실시간 교통정보 및 통계정보를 제공합니다. Coverage: 제주특별자치도. The portal files it under the publisher 제주특별자치도. Its tags are 교통정보, 시설물, 신호, 교통물류. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2016-05-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
